introMd: Magnet Simulator 2 puts you in control of a magnet, pulling in coins and pets to climb the ranks quickly. The thrill comes from upgrading your magnet and exploring new zones, but the real edge comes from using Magnet Simulator 2 codes. These codes unlock boosts, coins, and rare pets that can change how fast you level up and how strong your magnet becomes. Knowing when and how to use these codes can make a big difference in your gameplay experience.
redeemMd:
## How to Redeem Magnet Simulator Codes

Redeeming codes in Magnet Simulator 2 is easy and doesn’t require any special level or rank. Just follow these simple steps to get your rewards:

1. [[roblox_link|Launch Magnet Simulator 2]] and enter the game.
2. Look for the shopping cart icon on the left side of the screen and click it.
3. Inside the shop menu, find and click the Twitter icon.
4. A new window will pop up where you can enter your code.
5. Type or paste the code exactly as it appears.
6. Press the redeem button to claim your reward.

Make sure to enter the codes exactly as they are given to avoid errors.
rewardsMd:
## What Rewards You Normally Get?

When you redeem codes in Magnet Simulator 2, you usually receive items that directly impact your magnet’s power and your collecting speed. Here’s a clear breakdown of what you can expect:

| Reward Type | Description |
|-------------|-------------|
| Coins       | The main currency used to upgrade your magnet and buy pets. |
| Boosts      | Temporary multipliers that increase coin collection speed or magnet strength. |
| Pets        | Special companions that attract coins automatically, increasing your passive income. |

Each reward type plays a unique role in helping you gather more coins faster or maintain a steady income without constant clicking. Pets especially add a strategic layer, as some codes unlock rare or exclusive pets that you can’t get otherwise.
troubleshootMd:
## Why Codes Might Not Work

Sometimes codes don’t redeem properly, and here’s the main game-specific reason:

- Codes can expire quickly after release, so if you’re trying an old code, it won’t work anymore.

Outside of that, usual issues like typos or server problems apply but aren’t unique to Magnet Simulator 2.
